title: ROOF PANEL STRIKERS & HOUSING
summary: Coupe (19437) T-top (removable roof panel) latch hardware on the body: the front and rear latch housings along the windshield header/roof opening, the striker plates, and the rear roof locating wedge pins on plates at the rear roof (behind the T-tops). Housings and strikers are screwed on from below; the locating wedge pin and its plate are screwed to the rear roof edge with the plate cemented (57f) and the wedge lubricated (11a).
